change.scope: late-continuation + stale/failed-progress + multi-family opposition + runtime conflict + original score not supported

evidence.repeatFailure: EURUSD 1M B51-B56 showed repeated degradation; B55 and B56 provided fresh unseen confirmation of the same continuation/progress failure family.
evidence.whyNotGlobalThreshold: High-confidence buckets also degraded, so raising the global confidence floor would not address the failure mechanism and would harm frequency.
evidence.whyTargeted: The change requires simultaneous late-continuation risk, stale continuation, failed progress, at least two opposing evidence families, at least one runtime conflict, and lack of score support for the original direction.

checks: severe EURUSD 1M late-continuation/progress conflict reranks direction without changing frequency or threshold
fresh supported EURUSD 1M continuation remains unchanged

rollback.condition: Revert only V3.7 if unseen trigger-eligible EURUSD 1M outcomes degrade versus the pre-change failure baseline or create worse loss-run severity without compensating raw-accuracy improvement.

measure: max loss streak and 2+/3+/4+/5+ loss runs
